items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And in there comes Sophie Tucker, and all the big shows from downtown -- the big stars would come up. But they'd come upstairs to hear us.

ctx.x: And perform. See? And there's where all the people from downtown would come up, like Sophie Tucker

and Al Jolson. And oh, what is that thing that Al Jolson came up there and asked me to show him how to sing? Something about a little black boy. It'll come to me later, but I'll tell you later. He -- I didn't teach him how, but I showed him how I sang it, you know.
